channel.title: Behind Bars: Officer Cam
channel.desc: In Clayton County Jail, an inmate attacks another in handcuffs in one of the facility's most alarming acts of violence. Elsewhere, what looks like a fight reveals a far more complicated story once investigators piece together the full picture. And with contraband still flowing, Chief Green leads a sweeping shakedown that uncovers exactly how much is hiding in plain sight. Amid the chaos, officers defuse a tricky situation.
